8b8e4596c6de45d9.description: About EnglishBhashi EnglishBhashi is a product-led EdTech company building AI-powered language learning experiences for learners across India. Our mission is to make spoken English learning more personalized, practical, and accessible, particularly for learners from Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 cities. We are looking for an experienced Fractional Product Manager who can take meaningful ownership of our product and growth initiatives and work closely with the Founder and cross-functional teams to drive measurable outcomes. About the Role This is a high-ownership, founder-style product role. You will work approximately 3 hours per day with flexible working hours. The expectation is not about being available for a fixed number of hours, but about taking ownership of defined product outcomes and consistently moving them forward. You will be expected to think independently, identify opportunities, prioritize ruthlessly, work with data and users, and drive initiatives from: Problem Insight Hypothesis Product Launch Measurement Iteration You will work directly with the Founder and collaborate with Engineering, Design, Content, Marketing, and Community teams. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Ownership Understand EnglishBhashis product, users, business model, and growth objectives. Identify and prioritize the highest-impact product opportunities. Own and continuously improve the product roadmap. Define product priorities based on user impact, business value, data, and execution effort. Convert ambiguous business problems into clear product opportunities and initiatives. Work closely with the Founder on product strategy and important product decisions. User Research & Product Discovery Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and qualitative research. Develop a deep understanding of our learners, particularly Tier 2/3/4 audiences. Analyze user feedback, reviews, support conversations, and behavioral patterns. Identify key pain points affecting activation, engagement, learning outcomes, and retention. Study competitors and global language-learning products. Convert insights into product hypotheses, requirements, and experiments. Product Analytics & Funnel Optimization Own the product funnel across acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and conversion. Analyze product behavior using tools such as GA4, Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity. Identify funnel drop-offs, friction points, and behavioral patterns. Build and monitor cohorts and product metrics. Define and track product KPIs. Use data to identify opportunities and validate product decisions. Lifecycle, Engagement & Retention Own product-led engagement and retention initiatives. Design and optimize lifecycle journeys using CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, or similar platforms. Build segmentation, push notification, in-app messaging, and re-engagement journeys. Improve onboarding and activation experiences. Develop habit loops around daily learning and practice. Experiment with streaks, missions, reminders, rewards, and personalized nudges. Continuously work toward improving user retention and engagement. Product Execution Write PRDs, user stories, feature specifications, and acceptance criteria. Work closely with Engineering and Design to translate ideas into shipped products. Support wireframes and prototypes where required. Drive execution of prioritized initiatives. Participate in QA and release validation. Analyze post-launch performance and determine the next iteration. Ensure product initiatives do not stop at launch but are measured against outcomes. Growth & Experimentation Identify product-led growth opportunities. Develop hypotheses to improve activation, engagement, retention, and monetization. Design and execute product experiments and A/B tests. Measure experiment results and document learnings. Identify scalable growth loops within the product. Collaborate with Marketing, Content, and Community teams to improve the overall user journey. Strategic & Founder Support Work directly with the Founder on high-priority product and growth initiatives. Prepare product strategy documents, product briefs, dashboards, and presentations. Support investor, grant, accelerator, and strategic documentation when required. Bring structured thinking and data-driven decision-making to ambiguous problems. What Were Looking ForExperience 3-6 years of experience in Product Management, Growth Product, Consumer Apps, UX, MarTech, or a related role. Experience owning products, features, funnels, or growth initiatives end-to-end. Experience working in a startup or fast-paced product environment is strongly preferred. Must-Have Skills Strong product thinking and ownership mindset. Strong understanding of product funnels, activation, engagement, retention, and cohorts. Hands-on experience with GA4, Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar analytics tools. Hands-on experience with CleverTap .

8b42f85e2d484d1e.description: **About Us** We are an AI-driven analytics platform startup focused on building automated decision-making solutions. Our current focus is Athena, our decision intelligence product for the equipment finance industry — helping lenders turn underwriting, risk, and portfolio data into real-time, automated decisions. **Role Overview** This is a hybrid Business Analyst / Product Analyst role, sitting at the center of product and engineering. You'll translate business and founder requirements into specs our full-stack and data engineers can build against, get hands-on with data to validate what's being built, and own the day-to-day coordination that keeps product and engineering moving in sync. There will be a structured transition window supported by our current product lead — after that, you own this end-to-end. **What You'll Own** Translate founder and business requirements into clear specs and user stories for full-stack and data engineering teams Own day-to-day coordination between product and engineering — sprint planning, backlog grooming, unblocking work Get hands-on with data: write SQL queries to validate pipeline outputs and sanity-check product logic against our data architecture Build deep working knowledge of equipment finance — underwriting logic, asset classes, lease/loan structuring — so decision intelligence outputs actually make business sense Track delivery against roadmap and report directly to the founder **Must-Have** 2–5 years in business analysis, product analysis, or product management — fintech or lending exposure strongly preferred Strong SQL — comfortable writing and debugging queries against Postgres Working understanding of loan/lease or underwriting workflows in financial services Proven ability to write specs/requirements clear enough that engineers can build without hand-holding High agency — comfortable being the primary point of contact for engineering with minimal oversight **Nice-to-Have** Exposure to data pipeline concepts (ETL, orchestration tools like Dagster, layered/bronze-to-gold data architecture) Experience in equipment/asset finance, commercial lending, or NBFC underwriting Familiarity with product ops tools (Jira, Linear, Notion, or similar) **What We Offer** Full-time role with a structured transition period, supported directly by our current product lead Real ownership from day one — you'll shape how our decision intelligence products are specified and delivered, not just execute tickets Direct access to the founder, and a clear path to a Product Manager title as you take on more scope A small, sharp team solving a genuinely hard problem in equipment finance
